name: A Lesson to Learn
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids north to study the waters. Their road leads to Nighthaven in Moonglade, where the Cenarion Circle guides their training.

sections.title: Mastery of the Depths
sections.body: After learning the bear form and its physical might, your studies turn to adaptability. Azeroth's waterways bring hazards that landbound travelers cannot face easily. Turak Runetotem watches his students and sends those devoted to nature north to learn the aquatic form.

sections.title: The Road to Nighthaven
sections.body: Turak Runetotem sends you beyond Mulgore for guidance in shaping yourself for the waters. You travel to Moonglade, the sanctuary beneath Mount Hyjal, and reach Nighthaven. There, night elf mentors of the Cenarion Circle welcome tauren students. They set factional strife aside to preserve the shared teachings of Cenarius.

sections.title: The Dual Trials
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze waits for you in Nighthaven, where your training begins. The night elf elder says mastery over the waters must be earned. Two trials await: one tests your endurance and composure under water, and the other calls for deep spiritual understanding of the aquatic aspect.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Lesson to Learn?
aliases: who starts a lesson to learn
where do i get a lesson to learn
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem gives it from the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where he trains druids. When you have enough experience, he sends you for advanced training.

faq.q: Where must I go to complete this quest?
aliases: where do i turn in a lesson to learn
faq.answer: You travel to Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: What ability does this quest chain lead to?
faq.answer: This path leads to Aquatic Form, which lets you swim swiftly underwater and breathe beneath the surface without end.

faq.q: Why do tauren druids go to a night elf for training?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is a neutral brotherhood devoted to Cenarius and the preservation of nature. In Moonglade, night elves and tauren set Horde and Alliance tensions aside to learn the sacred arts together.

faq.q: What trials does Dendrite Starblaze speak of?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze tells you of two trials. One tests your composure under pressure underwater, and the other tests your spiritual resolve to understand the aquatic aspect.

faq.q: How does a druid reach Moonglade at this stage?
faq.answer: Druids can use Teleport: Moonglade, a spell born of their spiritual bond, to travel directly from anywhere in Azeroth to Nighthaven.

angles.text: As a druid, you leave terrestrial survival behind and begin learning to breathe and move underwater.
As a tauren, you join the druids of Thunder Bluff in the wider Cenarion brotherhood of Moonglade.
As a member of the Horde, you honor Moonglade's sacred neutrality and walk beside night elves beneath Cenarius's shared canopy.
